description: Land Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1631/12 of 08.12.2009, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District  - Cad. Map No. 510213 and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying land parcel classifications, extents, and particulars for multiple properties in various locations. The content focuses entirely on land registration matters, including cadastral mapping, land parcel numbers, title classifications, and extent amendments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
